entries.title: 摘要清单验证
entries.summary: 能验证两个离线文件的摘要清单，分别报告匹配和被修改文件。
entries.license: Original QFLI curriculum; reference link retained. CC BY 4.0
entries.expectedOutput:
a.txt exists=true match=true
b.txt exists=true match=false
bad-manifest=true

entries.title: HMAC 消息认证
entries.summary: 能为消息生成标签，验证正确消息并拒绝修改后的内容。
entries.license: Original QFLI curriculum; reference link retained. CC BY 4.0

entries.title: 定长令牌比较
entries.summary: 能先校验长度再比较固定字节令牌，展示错误输入和有效输入。
entries.license: Original QFLI curriculum; reference link retained. CC BY 4.0

entries.title: AES GCM 往返和篡改
entries.summary: 能每次生成新 nonce，往返验证消息并确认篡改密文会认证失败。
entries.license: Original QFLI curriculum; reference link retained. CC BY 4.0

entries.title: Ed25519 签名校验
entries.summary: 能生成临时密钥，签名本地清单并验证原文与篡改文。
entries.license: Original QFLI curriculum; reference link retained. CC BY 4.0

entries.title: ECDSA 摘要签名
entries.summary: 能对 SHA256 摘要进行 ASN1 签名与验证，拒绝另一摘要。
entries.license: Original QFLI curriculum; reference link retained. CC BY 4.0

entries.title: 密钥协商一致性
entries.summary: 能两方生成临时 P256 密钥，独立推导共享秘密并比较一致性。
entries.license: Original QFLI curriculum; reference link retained. CC BY 4.0

entries.title: 公钥 PEM 往返
entries.summary: 能编码和读取公钥 PEM，检查块类型并验证恢复后的公钥。
entries.license: Original QFLI curriculum; reference link retained. CC BY 4.0

entries.title: CRC32 分片校验
entries.summary: 能分片更新校验和并与一次性校验对比，演示一个字节变化的检测。
entries.license: Original QFLI curriculum; reference link retained. CC BY 4.0

entries.title: 流式多摘要
entries.summary: 能用 MultiWriter 一次消费输入同时计算两类摘要并验证长度与一致性。
